name: discretize

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.13.0"
  # ensure is_freethreading gets detected as a used variable
  touch_is_freethreading: ${{ is_freethreading }}

package:
  name: discretize
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/d/discretize/discretize-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: eeb2ca7cf2c43b86842ed517a3e31281eaf464a97098b5c0b3f64a789f197fc0

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - match(python, "<" ~ python_min)
    # the abi3 build is made once on python_min and covers every later (non-freethreading) python
    - is_abi3 and not match(python, python_min ~ ".*")
    - match(python, "=3.14") and linux and is_freethreading and (aarch64 or ppc64le)
  python:
    version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
  script:
    - if: unix
      then:
        # configure with meson directly so ${MESON_ARGS} (the cross file for osx-arm64, linux-aarch64 and linux-ppc64le) is used
        - mkdir builddir
        - export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=$(numpy-config --pkgconfigdir):${PKG_CONFIG_PATH}
        - if: is_abi3
          then: meson setup ${MESON_ARGS} builddir/
          # Cython can't target the free-threaded stable ABI (abi3t) yet, so those builds opt out of the limited API
          else: meson setup ${MESON_ARGS} -Dpython.allow_limited_api=false builddir/
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv --no-build-isolation --config-settings=builddir=builddir
      else:
        - if: is_abi3
          then: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv --no-build-isolation
          else: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv --no-build-isolation -Csetup-args=-Dpython.allow_limited_api=false

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython >=3.1.0
        - numpy
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
        - meson-python >=0.21.0
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
  host:
    - if: is_abi3
      then: python-abi3
    - python
    - pip
    - meson-python >=0.21.0
    - ninja
    - pkg-config
    - cython >=3.1.0
    - numpy
    - setuptools_scm >=6.2
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=1.26.0
    - scipy >=1.12

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - discretize
      python_version:
        - if: is_abi3
          then: ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - python -c "import discretize; print(discretize.__version__)"
      - python -c "from importlib.metadata import version; print(version('discretize'))"
  - if: is_abi3
    then:
      requirements:
        run:
          - abi3audit
      script:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - abi3audit $SP_DIR/discretize/_extensions/*.abi3.so -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
          else:
            - for %%f in (%SP_DIR%\discretize\_extensions\*.pyd) do abi3audit "%%f" -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}

about:
  homepage: http://github.com/simpeg/discretize
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Discretization tools for finite volume and inverse problems
  repository: https://github.com/simpeg/discretize
  documentation: https://discretize.simpeg.xyz

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - lheagy
    - jcapriot
